name: Speed
description: Trades memory for speed by turning back on what Breached trims: tabs stay loaded instead of sleeping after 15 minutes, a spare process waits so new tabs and sites open sooner, up to 8 page processes, a bigger memory cache, link prefetching and shaders ready at start. Expect roughly 150-400 MB more memory. :speed shows what it changed.

settings.label: Keep tabs loaded (no sleeping after 15 minutes)
settings.hint: Going back to an old tab is instant instead of reloading it. Tabs still sleep if Windows runs low on memory.
